definition.candidate_contract: Both edit-before C/output and current C; more information than current-C-only generator

definition.cross_condition_coverage: Fraction of the same corresponding GT points at distance <=0.01*L0

definition.score_L0_columns: Original distance_%Lalpha multiplied by Lalpha/L0 without coordinate changes
definition.width: Equal triangle-corner q95-q05; numpy quantile method=linear
